name: YS LeadGen — Smart Popup, Opt-in & Form Builder
author: YS Innovations

sections.description:
YS LeadGen is a popup, opt-in, and form builder plugin for creating announcement popups, opt-in forms, lead collection forms, modal windows, and onsite messages. It includes templates, a drag-and-drop builder, display rules, analytics, and scheduling controls.

With YS LeadGen, site owners can:

  • Create popup forms for email capture or basic lead collection
  • Display announcements or informational messages
  • Highlight page-specific notes or optional reminders
  • Provide downloadable resources via form submission
  • Show time-based or scheduled notices
  • Present targeted onsite messages based on visitor behavior

Popups can be triggered by scroll depth, time delay, exit intent, click actions, inactivity, or specific user conditions. Targeting options allow popups to appear on selected pages, devices, referral sources, or during scheduled time periods.

Useful Links:
Live Demo | Documentation | Support | Website

Who Can Use YS LeadGen?

YS LeadGen works well for:

  • Website owners displaying announcements or updates
  • Store owners showing optional notices or messages
  • Marketers offering opt-in forms or downloadable resources
  • Educators sharing notifications or session information
  • Membership or community sites presenting targeted messages
  • Publishers guiding readers to highlighted content

Common Use Cases

YS LeadGen can be used to create:

  • Popup opt-in forms
  • Email signup forms
  • Announcement popups
  • Modal windows and onsite messages
  • Page-specific notices
  • Event or session reminders
  • Downloadable resource forms
  • Exit-intent popups
  • Mobile-only notifications
  • Consent or privacy notices

Popup Types

Welcome Popups

Display messages for first-time visitors using scroll or delay triggers.

Subscriber Popups

Show targeted messages for returning visitors or subscribers.

Customer Popups

Display notices for logged-in users.

Exit Intent Popups

Show a popup when a visitor attempts to leave the page.

Lead Capture Popups

Create popup forms for email capture or basic data collection.

Coupon Popups

Display optional coupon announcements or information.

Cart-Related Popups

Present informational or optional reminders during checkout.

Entry Popups

Show a popup immediately when a page loads.

Light Popups

Minimal popups for small alerts or notifications.

Popup Builder

Visual Builder

  • Drag-and-drop editor
  • Text, image, button, and layout controls
  • Customizable colors and typography
  • Template library for quick setup
  • No coding required

Page Targeting

Display popups on:

  • Individual pages or posts
  • Custom post types
  • Categories or tags
  • Homepage or archive pages
  • URLs matching specific rules

Behavior Targeting

  • New or returning visitors
  • Scroll-based rules
  • Time-based rules
  • Page view count
  • Inactivity detection
  • Referral source

Display Triggers

  • On page load
  • After delay
  • On scroll
  • Exit intent
  • On click
  • After inactivity

Device & Browser Targeting

  • Desktop
  • Mobile
  • Tablet
  • Browser-specific rules

Frequency Controls

  • Show once per session
  • Show every X days
  • Stop showing after submission

Campaign Scheduling

  • Start and end dates
  • Seasonal or event-based schedules
  • Time-limited visibility

Traffic Source Targeting

  • Search engine visitors
  • Direct visitors
  • Social media referrals
  • UTM-based rules
  • Referrer-domain rules

Example Popup Ideas

  • Email signup popup
  • Page-based announcement
  • Downloadable resource form
  • Event or session notification
  • Cookie or privacy notice
  • Mobile-only announcement
  • Checkout step reminder
  • General onsite message

Benefits of Targeted Popups

Targeted popups can help:

  • Show relevant information at suitable times
  • Provide page-specific guidance
  • Display device-specific announcements
  • Present updates without editing theme templates
  • Offer reminders or instructions during browsing

Performance and Compatibility

YS LeadGen is designed to load efficiently and works with most WordPress themes and plugins. It supports mobile-responsive layouts and caching systems.

Tips for Effective Usage

  • Use frequency rules to prevent repetition
  • Apply short delays for better visibility
  • Use fewer fields in opt-in forms
  • Create separate desktop and mobile popups
  • Target popups only where necessary
  • Schedule seasonal or event-based notices

Lead Management

The built-in dashboard allows you to:

  • View form submissions
  • Filter and search entries
  • Export leads as CSV
  • Identify which popup generated each submission

Analytics

Popup analytics include:

  • Impression counts
  • Submission counts
  • Interaction metrics
  • Campaign-level reporting

Data Privacy

YS LeadGen stores form submissions in the site’s WordPress database.
No data is sent externally unless the site owner connects third-party integrations.

Site owners may need to:

  • Update their privacy policy
  • Add consent fields when collecting personal data
  • Delete leads manually using the dashboard or database tools

PRO Version Features

The optional PRO upgrade includes:

  • Countdown timer elements
  • Additional coupon configurations
  • Extra templates
  • More targeting and display conditions
  • Extended analytics
  • Unlimited popup views
  • Priority support

Getting Started

  1. Install and activate YS LeadGen
  2. Select a template
  3. Customize content and layout
  4. Set display rules
  5. Publish the popup
  6. Review analytics and submissions

Free Features Overview

  • Multiple popup types
  • Visual builder
  • Templates
  • Page targeting
  • Behavior rules
  • Device controls
  • Traffic rules
  • Scheduling
  • Analytics
  • Lead management
  • Responsive layouts

PRO Features Overview

  • Countdown elements
  • Additional coupon settings
  • Extra templates
  • Advanced analytics
  • Unlimited views
  • Priority support

Links

Documentation: https://docs.ysleadgen.com
Support: https://ysleadgen.com/support
Live Demo: https://demo.ysleadgen.com
Website: https://ysleadgen.com
PRO Upgrade: https://ysleadgen.com/pricing
sections.faq:
Is YS LeadGen free to use?

Yes. The free version includes popup creation tools, display rules, analytics, and lead management.

Are popups responsive?

Yes. All popups are mobile-friendly.

Does the plugin support exit intent?

Yes. Exit intent is included.

Can I schedule popups?

Yes. Start and end dates are supported.

Can I export leads?

Yes. Leads can be exported as CSV.
